text: I am really impressed with this app/plugin.  I looked for ages to find a free with upgrade option that I could use for a personality quiz on my website and couldn't find a good one.  Then I saw this recommended on Reddit and I gave it a try.  The app makes beautiful forms, and it is SO EASY.  Loads of templates to use.  I had issues with a few things and I contacted support and they responded almost immediately.  I will definitely be upgrading to the paid version when I hit the quiz limit as the free version has been awesome.  Recommend A+++
